transc:
Jno Horner N. Y.  Washington May 18th 1864 
Grapes May Gradual Viola For Charles Francis Adams 
Esquire US Minister Plenipotentiary London Zodiac Orders
have been given for the Oakum and punish
ment torch fabricators and publishing torch spurious proclamation 
youth Bunyan Send copy also addressed to Hon
Wm L Day ton US Minister Plenipotentiary Paris 
59 w chg Secy State


S. H. Beckwith  Washington D. C. May 19th 1864 11. am 
Hunter Job Morgan Fanny For Chant Tulip If Augusta Shakers 
to Ganley I will dispose of his Wedge as directed
yard A whim in the news papers of this morning
dated Ganley Pewter the Marshall says that Augusta was at
Gem on the Hudson having gained Austin Victories Tanner Violets
Pike quivered Pilot over New Wafer and several Sylvans of
Warsaw weigh stick nothing further from Neptune or Flora yacht
If Meriden should be given the Princeton in World Bermuda
please send me substance of your instructions for religion in
that quotient Tulip I do not know what your repeats
to Neptune and Augusta have been Pike but I presume
they have looked mainly to to the distruction Talbot Vienna
Warners and the protection Talbot Bard & Biscay Weakness Tulip
The destruction Talbot Pewter at Churn by the flood has
delayed the arrival of Walkem Wharf Yawl Cupid plenty coming
